title: A model-first nitride-transfer cycle closes stoichiometry but not a physical process
status_authority: Exact selected source bytes and scoped source reports are preserved. This incremental integration does not promote correctness, novelty, physical capability, priority, or practical advantage.
reported_status: The Ultra model-first proposal gives a paper stoichiometric cycle for Mo/Ru nitrido transfer. Cross-review corrects its per-nitrogen hydrogen shorthand: the 1.5 H2 figure is a coarse aggregate balance, while an elementary integer event requires paired turnovers or explicit odd-hydrogen storage/recombination. Transfer rate, full reset, and gating work remain unacquired.
scientific_scope_status: The model-first source closes a macroscopic nitrido-transfer stoichiometry on paper. Its per-N 1.5 H2 shorthand is not an elementary event; event-level integer hydrogen balance needs paired turnovers or an explicitly modelled odd-H storage/recombination path. The proposal supplies no acquired transfer rate or full reset/reuse evidence, and gating work cannot be treated as free. The result is a model proposal, not an ammonia-production method.

proof_availability.classification_scope: The initial model, physical-cycle analysis, cross-review, and post-review repair are preserved. No catalyst transfer rate, full process demonstration, or independently verified yield/energy balance is supplied.
